sections.visual_description: A dramatic illustration of a collapsing star forming a black hole, with spacetime bending and warping around it. The singularity at the center represented as a point of infinite curvature. Minimalist editorial style with deep blacks and subtle light rays.
sections.caption: 时空的终极命运

sections.h2_title: 第一章：预备知识——时空的数学结构
sections.visual_description: A clean diagram showing the structure of spacetime with light cones - future light cone, past light cone, and spacelike regions. Geometric representation of Lorentzian manifold. Editorial illustration style.
sections.caption: 时空的数学结构

sections.h2_title: 第二章：能量条件——物质的物理约束
sections.visual_description: An abstract representation of energy conditions in physics - vectors and tensors visualized with geometric arrows. Clean line art showing the relationship between energy-momentum and spacetime curvature.
sections.caption: 能量条件

sections.h2_title: 第三章：Raychaudhuri方程——奇点定理的核心工具
sections.visual_description: A diagram showing a congruence of geodesics converging toward a focal point. Rays of light bending inward due to gravity. The focusing effect visualized with clean geometric lines.
sections.caption: 测地线聚焦

sections.h2_title: 第四章：彭罗斯奇点定理——黑洞的必然性
sections.visual_description: An illustration of a closed trapped surface - a spherical region where even outward-directed light is bent back by gravity. The concept of gravitational collapse visualized. Editorial illustration.
sections.caption: 闭合捕获面

sections.h2_title: 第五章：霍金奇点定理——宇宙的起点
sections.visual_description: A dramatic visualization of the Big Bang - the initial singularity of the universe. Light emanating from a central point representing the beginning of time and space. Cosmic expansion editorial illustration.
sections.caption: 宇宙的起点

sections.h2_title: 第六章：奇点的本质与类型
sections.visual_description: A comparative diagram showing different types of singularities - spacelike, timelike, and null. Geometric representations of spacetime diagrams with different singularity structures.
sections.caption: 奇点的类型

sections.h2_title: 第七章：意义、局限与展望
sections.visual_description: An abstract representation of quantum gravity - discrete spacetime, string theory vibrations, or loop quantum gravity spin networks. Conceptual illustration of physics beyond general relativity.
sections.caption: 量子引力展望

sections.h2_title: 结语：数学之美的物理回响
sections.visual_description: A contemplative illustration of a person looking up at the night sky, with subtle mathematical equations and geometric patterns in the background. Elegant editorial style representing the harmony of mathematics and physics.
sections.caption: 数学与物理
